note: Spoken crew traffic for CrewVoice. Original wording in ordinary radio and naval phraseology. {track} is spoken digit by digit, {name} is a platform's spoken name. Each event keeps at least one variant with no placeholder, for when the field is not known.

investigate_ack: Aye, closing to get eyes on.
torpedo_away: Fish in the water, running normal.
Weapon launched, running hot and straight.
inbound_missile: Inbound missile, all stations stand by to defend.
Missile inbound, engaging with everything we have.
torpedo_inbound: Torpedo in the water, coming our way!
target_destroyed: Good hits, the target is going down.
attack_broken_off: Breaking off the attack on track {track}.
Attack on track {track} ended, awaiting orders.
own_ship_hit: We're hit! Damage control parties away.
Hit, hit! Damage control to stations.
unit_lost: Contact lost with one of ours. She's gone.
aircraft_rtb: Fuel state critical, coming back to mother.
fire_out: Fire is out, reflash watch set.
Fire out, damage control standing by.
mission_won: Mission accomplished. Well done, all stations.
Objectives achieved. Stand down from action stations.
mission_lost: Mission failed. All units, break off.
We have failed the mission. Disengage and withdraw.
